strings: r_c0 talks to m_c, discussing together why {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} been feeling so listless and uncomfortable around camp recently.
No matter what m_c seems to do, it just feels like something is off this moon.
Frustrated, m_c snaps at a Clanmate to leave {PRONOUN/m_c/object} alone, only to regret it and apologise heartbeats later. Something is off with {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
m_c rocks back and forth, trying to get rid of this painful boredom.
